summary: Miles Academy (new persona-based academic coach) end-to-end validation PASSED. 35/35 new Miles backend tests + 35/35 Max+Maya regression = 70/70 green. Frontend flows verified via Playwright on deployed URL with pre-seeded parent account: parent-miles-cta opens miles-intro-screen with 3 persona cards (ivy/vance/drake) + documentary opt-in (yes/maybe/no), continue disabled until persona picked; submitting persona routes to miles-chat-screen with correct persona-themed avatar/color (Vance=amber verified), 30/30 chip, subject dropdown (miles-subject-math works), live Claude reply decrements chip to 29/30, miles-back-btn returns to parent dashboard. Upgrade wall (miles_daily_count=30) renders miles-upgrade-wall with miles-upgrade-founding-btn → miles-founding-screen shows $9.5/mo + first 50 families + agree checkbox + lock btn → successful signup shows 'You're Founding Miles #1'. Counter isolation confirmed: sending miles chat does NOT mutate daily_count or parent_daily_count; sending family chat does NOT mutate miles_daily_count. Parent test account fully reset post-tests per main agent spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1907 lines (up from 1389) — adding Miles on top of Max + Maya keeps compounding the single-file maintainability risk flagged in iterations 1 & 2. Split into routers/ (max_router.py, maya_router.py, miles_router.py, admin_router.py) + services/ (memory.py) + prompts/ is increasingly urgent before next feature lands.
MILES_PERSONAS dict bakes the full system prompts (600+ chars each) directly into server.py next to routes. Move to /app/backend/prompts/miles_personas.py to keep the module skimmable.

Miles memory summarization runs synchronously in the chat request (same pattern as Maya). A 6th-message user sees ~1-2s extra latency from the Haiku call. Consider FastAPI BackgroundTask once latency matters.

Three daily counters now live on the User model (daily_count / parent_daily_count / miles_daily_count) with parallel *_date and *_exchange_count_since_summary fields. This triplicate field explosion is a refactor candidate — a nested {tracks: {max:{...}, maya:{...}, miles:{...}}} sub-document would DRY it cleanly.

/api/miles/founding-signup allows signup even BEFORE the user picks a persona (only onboarding+auth checks). Probably intentional (waitlist is brand-level, not persona-level) but worth a product decision.
CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True still present — same flag as iteration_1 & 2.

Miles nudge banner for final_five correctly includes '$9.50' / 'founding' copy per spec — but nudge wording is injected via system-prompt hint AND returned as a deterministic `nudge` field in the response. Frontend reads the deterministic field — good; just document that the LLM-appended line is best-effort.
